title: Haroon Meer (Thinkst Canary) — 'His new book, Incorruptible, is more important' than The Lean Startup
summary: Haroon Meer — founder of Thinkst (Thinkst Canary), one of the most respected voices in cybersecurity — endorses Incorruptible on LinkedIn and X, calling it more important than The Lean Startup for anyone building a company. Frames it against the pattern he sees in his own field: founders being told that principled choices are unique and non-repeatable, when Eric shows they aren't.
blockquote:
If you built a company in the past decade u probably received advice from the Eric Ries classic: “The Lean Startup”.

His new book, “Incorruptible” is more important.

We’ve been told constantly how choices we made at Thinkst Canary are unique/non-repeatable. He shows otherwise.

If you are building a cyber-startup, you should read this book.
